metric: Pairs shown different by a constraint-respecting database on which both queries were run (DuckDB), and pairs on which 150 random databases showed no difference (not a proof, not bounded verification) sample of 1,000 of the 23,994 pairs, every 24th.
correctness: Every refutation was executed on both queries and is stable under row-order shuffles; none are claimed without a database
caveats: Sample only (every 24th pair); the full corpus has not been run yet. No labels. Dialect: MySQL source, DuckDB execution. 'unknown' here counts pairs that agree on every random database; 'unsupported' counts pairs DuckDB or the parser rejects.
